title: Kien Viet Magazine Features the Gao Lut House Project
description: Gao Lut House by MVN Group was featured by Kien Viet Magazine as a sustainable architectural project that harmoniously integrates natural light, rustic materials, and a strong connection with nature.
author: MVN Group
content:
Kien Viet Magazine has published an article featuring Gao Lut House by MVN Group, highlighting the project’s design concept, architectural solutions, and the spatial values it brings. The project is recognized for its sustainable approach, where natural light, traditional brick, and reclaimed wood are thoughtfully utilized as key elements to create a warm, emotional, and nature-connected living environment.

Through the combination of natural materials, passive ventilation strategies, and flexible spatial organization, Gao Lut House not only meets the family’s living needs but also reflects an architectural philosophy that seeks balance between people, nature, and the surrounding environment. The project represents a harmonious blend of traditional values and contemporary design thinking, creating a sustainable, welcoming, and timeless living space.
